You can use Node.js 26 with Powertools for AWS Lambda (TypeScript) , a developer toolkit to implement serverless best practices and increase developer velocity. You can also use the full range of AWS deployment tools, including the Lambda console, AWS CLI, AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM), AWS CDK, and AWS CloudFormation to deploy and manage serverless applications written in Node.js 26. The Node.js 26 runtime is available in all Regions where Web Functions and Event Functions are available. For more information about Node.js 26 in Lambda, refer to the Web Function and Event Function documentation. For more information about AWS Lambda, visit our product page .
articles.summary: AWS Lambda prend désormais en charge Node.js 26 pour les fonctions Web et les fonctions événementielles, en tant que runtime géré et, pour les fonctions événementielles, comme image de conteneur de base. Cette version LTS est prise en charge jusqu'en avril 2029 et offre notamment l'API Temporal et des améliorations de l'API Fetch. Le runtime est disponible dans toutes les régions où ces fonctions sont offertes.
articles.title: AWS Lambda adds support for Node.js 26

articles.excerpt: Amazon S3 now supports at least 11,000 GET/HEAD requests per second, up from 5,500, for general purpose buckets. With this higher request rate, you can retrieve data faster for read-intensive workloads such as machine learning training, data analytics, and data transfers. To maximize throughput, distribute your requests across multiple prefixes so that S3 can scale each one independently. This increase applies automatically to your existing read requests in all AWS Regions, with no changes required to your applications and at no additional charge beyond standard S3 request pricing. To learn more, visit the Amazon S3 user guide and the S3 product page .
articles.summary: Amazon S3 porte à au moins 11 000 requêtes GET/HEAD par seconde (contre 5 500 auparavant) le débit de lecture des compartiments à usage général. Cette hausse s'applique automatiquement à toutes les Régions AWS, sans modification d'application ni frais supplémentaires au-delà de la tarification standard. Pour maximiser le débit, il est recommandé de répartir les requêtes sur plusieurs préfixes.
articles.title: Amazon S3 increases the read request rate for general purpose buckets by up to 2x

articles.excerpt: AWS Lambda now supports creating serverless applications using Python 3.15. Python 3.15 is generally available for Lambda Event Functions and is available in public preview for Lambda Web Functions. This is the first Python runtime for Web Functions, which until now only supported Node.js. With this launch, developers can also build web applications and APIs on Web Functions in Python. Developers can use Python 3.15 as both a managed runtime and a base container image (Event Functions only), and AWS will automatically apply updates to the managed runtime and base image as they become available. Python 3.15 is the latest release of Python. With this release, you can use the latest Python 3.15 features in Lambda, such as explicit lazy imports that can reduce function startup time, the new frozendict and sentinel built-in types, and an improved JIT compiler. You can use Python 3.15 with Powertools for AWS Lambda (Python) , a developer toolkit to implement serverless best practices and increase developer velocity. You can also use the full range of AWS deployment tools, including the Lambda console, AWS CLI, AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM), AWS CDK, and AWS CloudFormation to deploy and manage serverless applications written in Python 3.15. The Python 3.15 runtime is available in all Regions where Event Functions and Web Functions are available. For more information about Python 3.15 in Lambda, refer to the Event Function and Web Function documentation. For more…
articles.summary: AWS Lambda prend désormais en charge Python 3.15 pour les fonctions événementielles, en disponibilité générale, et en préversion publique pour les fonctions Web, première fois que Python est offert sur ce type de fonctions, jusqu'ici réservées à Node.js. Le runtime est disponible comme environnement géré et comme image de base de conteneur (fonctions événementielles seulement), avec mises à jour automatiques. Il est disponible dans toutes les régions où les deux types de fonctions sont offerts.
articles.title: AWS Lambda adds support for Python 3.15

articles.excerpt: AWS CloudFormation now supports up to 300,000 stacks in each AWS account and Region by default (previously 2,000), which enables you to add stacks as your workloads grow without requesting a quota increase. CloudFormation manages related AWS resources as a stack that you create, update, and delete as one unit. Teams that deploy a separate stack for each customer, environment, or developer can now scale those patterns within a single account. A higher default quota allows you to keep growing workloads in the accounts where they already run. Previously, accounts that needed more than 2,000 stacks in a Region requested a quota increase through Service Quotas. Now, the default quota covers these workloads without a request. For example, a software provider that deploys one stack for each customer can grow from 2,000 to 300,000 customer stacks in one account and Region. Existing stacks work without changes. The higher quota applies to stacks you create in the CloudFormation console or with the AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, AWS CDK, or AWS SAM. To view your stacks per account quota, open the Service Quotas console. For more information, see CloudFormation quotas in the AWS CloudFormation User Guide. The increased quota is available at no additional charge in all AWS Regions where AWS CloudFormation is supported. For Region availability, see the AWS Region table .
articles.summary: AWS CloudFormation porte à 300 000 le nombre de piles par compte et par région par défaut, contre 2 000 auparavant, sans qu'une demande d'augmentation de quota soit nécessaire. La hausse s'applique aux piles créées via la console, l'AWS CLI, les SDK, l'AWS CDK ou AWS SAM, sans frais supplémentaires dans toutes les régions où le service est offert.
articles.title: AWS CloudFormation increases the default stacks per account quota to 300,000

articles.excerpt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime instances now support Amazon EC2 G7 instances, powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs. Runtime instances run your agents on Amazon EC2 instances while AgentCore handles provisioning, patching, scaling, and lifecycle management. G7 instances give agents that do 3D rendering or model inference another GPU option, alongside families such as G6e and G7e. To use G7, add G7 instance types, from g7.2xlarge to g7.48xlarge, to the allowed instance types of your capacity provider. AgentCore installs the NVIDIA drivers on the instance, so standard container images run GPU workloads without bundling drivers. For example, an agent can render 3D scenes or run a vision model on its own GPU, in sessions of up to 14 days . G7 instances on runtime instances are available in select AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (London), Europe (Stockholm), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), and Asia Pacific (Sydney). You are charged for managing the provisioned compute, in addition to your Amazon EC2 costs. To get started, see the following resources: Use GPU instance types in the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Developer Guide AgentCore pricing
articles.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore prend désormais en charge les instances Amazon EC2 G7, équipées de GPU NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition, pour exécuter des agents nécessitant du rendu 3D ou de l'inférence de modèles. Les types g7.2xlarge à g7.48xlarge doivent être ajoutés aux types d'instances autorisés du fournisseur de capacité, et les pilotes NVIDIA sont installés automatiquement. Le service est offert dans huit régions AWS, dont plusieurs en Amérique du Nord et en Europe, en plus des coûts EC2 habituels.
articles.title: AgentCore runtime instances now support Amazon EC2 G7 instances

articles.excerpt: ​​Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Db2 now supports renaming databases in place. You can rename a database on your DB instance by calling the new rdsadmin.rename_database stored procedure. Previously, renaming a database required you to back it up and restore it under a new name. With rename, the database keeps its data in place, so it's faster than backing up and restoring the database.​ ​​Database rename simplifies workflows such as replacing a database with a restored copy. For example, after you restore a copy of a database from a backup, you can rename the original database, and then give its name to the restored copy, without changing your application connection strings. Database rename runs as a background task that you can monitor with rdsadmin.get_task_status.​ ​​Database rename is available in all AWS Regions where Amazon RDS for Db2 is offered. To get started, see the Amazon RDS User Guide .​​
articles.summary: Amazon RDS for Db2 permet désormais de renommer une base de données sur place, au moyen de la procédure stockée rdsadmin.rename_database, sans passer par une sauvegarde et une restauration. L'opération s'exécute en arrière-plan et son état se suit avec rdsadmin.get_task_status. Elle est disponible dans toutes les régions AWS où le service est offert.
articles.title: ​​​Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports renaming databases​

articles.excerpt: ​​Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports four new time zones, America/Vancouver, America/Edmonton, America/Inuvik, and America/Winnipeg, that reflect the updated local time rules for British Columbia, Alberta, the Northwest Territories, and Manitoba in Canada. As of November 1, 2026, these provinces and territories observe permanent daylight saving time and no longer set their clocks back by an hour.​ ​Data stored in UTC is unaffected, but values based on the instance's local time, such as CURRENT TIMESTAMP, CURRENT DATE, default timestamp columns, scheduled jobs, and business-day batch logic, can be affected. With these new time zones, you can keep local time values accurate for workloads operating in these regions. ​​You can select the new time zones when you create a new RDS for Db2 instance. To change the time zone of an existing instance, contact AWS Support, as modifying the time zone of an existing instance is not supported through the AWS CLI, API, or SDK. If your instances serve workloads in these regions, we recommend reviewing them and updating your time zone configuration to avoid incorrect local times in your applications.​ ​The new time zones are available in all AWS Regions where Amazon RDS for Db2 is offered. To learn more and see the full list of supported time zones, visit the Amazon RDS for Db2 time zone documentation .​
articles.summary: Amazon RDS for Db2 ajoute quatre nouveaux fuseaux horaires canadiens : America/Vancouver, America/Edmonton, America/Inuvik et America/Winnipeg, qui reflètent l'heure locale mise à jour de la Colombie-Britannique, de l'Alberta, des Territoires du Nord-Ouest et du Manitoba. Ces provinces et territoires adopteront l'heure avancée permanente à partir du 1er novembre 2026, ce qui peut affecter les valeurs d'heure locale des instances (CURRENT TIMESTAMP, tâches planifiées, traitements de jours ouvrables), sans effet sur les données en UTC. Le fuseau se choisit à la création d'une instance ; pour une instance existante, il faut passer par AWS Support.
articles.title: Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports new Canadian time zones

articles.excerpt: Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports object-level audit policies, giving you fine-grained control over which database objects are audited. You can create custom audit policies and attach them to specific tables, users, groups, roles, and authorities in your RDS for Db2 databases. With object-level audit policies, you can focus on auditing the objects that matter most — for example, a single table that contains sensitive data or a specific user — without generating audit records for your entire database. Object-level audit policies complement the existing database-level audit logging in Amazon RDS for Db2. You can use both at the same time, and they operate independently. Amazon RDS provides stored procedures to create, modify, attach, detach, and drop object-level audit policies. Audit records are uploaded to the same Amazon S3 bucket that you configured for Db2 audit logging. Object-level audit policies for Amazon RDS for Db2 are available in all AWS Regions where Amazon RDS for Db2 is available. To get started see the Amazon RDS User Guide.
articles.summary: Amazon RDS for Db2 permet désormais de définir des politiques d'audit au niveau des objets, attachables à des tables, utilisateurs, groupes, rôles ou autorités précis. Elles s'utilisent en parallèle de l'audit au niveau de la base, et les enregistrements sont envoyés au même bucket Amazon S3 que celui configuré pour l'audit Db2. La fonctionnalité est disponible dans toutes les régions où Amazon RDS for Db2 est offert.
articles.title: Amazon RDS for Db2 now supports object-level audit policies

articles.excerpt: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for SQL Server 2019 CU32 + GDR KB5128494 (RDS version 15.00.4500.2.v1) and SQL Server 2022 CU27 + GDR KB5126934 (RDS version 16.00.4305.5.v1). For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5128494 and KB5126934. You can upgrade your Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server instances to apply these recommended updates using Amazon RDS Management Console, or by using the AWS SDK or CLI. To learn more about upgrading your database instances, see Amazon RDS Custom User Guide .
articles.summary: Amazon RDS Custom pour SQL Server prend désormais en charge les dernières mises à jour cumulatives (CU) et GDR de Microsoft SQL Server. Les versions incluses sont SQL Server 2019 CU32 + GDR KB5128494 et SQL Server 2022 CU27 + GDR KB5126934. Les instances peuvent être mises à niveau via la console Amazon RDS, l'AWS SDK ou l'AWS CLI.
articles.title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server

articles.excerpt: Amazon Route 53 now supports Availability Zone (AZ) affinity routing, which routes DNS queries from your VPCs to resources in the same AZ as the client that sends the query. This helps you keep traffic within the same AZ as the client, reducing latency and improving application performance. Until now, customers who wanted lower latency used other routing policies, such as latency-based or geoproximity routing. With this launch, DNS queries from your clients are answered with resources in the same AZ. This keeps traffic within the AZ and gives your clients faster responses. If there's no record for the client's AZ, Route 53 falls back to a record for a less specific location: the Zone Group, then the AWS Region, and then Global, in the same order. To get started, create AZ-affinity records and choose a location type for each: Availability Zone, Zone Group, Region, or Global. For Availability Zone records, specify the AZ ID, such as use1-az1. You can associate a health check with any AZ-affinity record, whether it's for an AZ, a Zone Group, or a Region. If the endpoint is unhealthy, Route 53 answers with the record for the next location. You can use AZ-affinity routing for records in both public and private hosted zones. The Global record answers queries that don't come from your VPCs, such as queries from the internet. You can create AZ-affinity records with the Route 53 console, API, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, and AWS CloudFormation. AZ-affinity routing is available in all AWS…
articles.summary: Amazon Route 53 prend désormais en charge le routage d'affinité par zone de disponibilité (AZ) : les requêtes DNS provenant de vos VPC sont dirigées vers les ressources situées dans la même AZ que le client, ce qui réduit la latence. Si aucun enregistrement n'existe pour l'AZ du client, Route 53 se replie successivement sur le groupe de zones, puis la région, puis l'enregistrement global; une vérification de santé peut être associée à ces enregistrements.
articles.title: Amazon Route 53 now supports Availability Zone (AZ) affinity routing

articles.excerpt: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) IP Address Manager (IPAM) policies now support AWS Network Firewall automated internet firewall and AWS Lambda Web Functions and MicroVMs. You can centrally configure IPAM policies across AWS accounts and AWS Regions to allocate public IPv4 addresses to these resources from specific IPAM pools, such as Bring Your Own IP (BYOIP) addresses or Amazon-provided contiguous IPv4 blocks. This enables a stronger security posture, simplifies network and security operations, and can reduce public IPv4 costs when you use BYOIP. Many customers allowlist the public IPs of their AWS resources in network access control lists (ACLs) and firewalls. Previously, keeping these resources on allowlisted addresses depended on each application team. With this launch, you can define allocation rules for them alongside existing resource types, so security teams can add IP-based filters with confidence that these resources draw addresses from approved ranges. For Lambda Web Functions and MicroVMs, this covers the public IPv4 addresses used for outbound traffic through Lambda Network Connectors. If a pool runs out of addresses, resources fall back to Amazon-provided addresses. You can also share allocated ranges with partners through IPAM integration with AWS prefix lists. The feature is available in all AWS commercial Regions, in both the Free Tier and Advanced Tier of VPC IPAM. To learn more, see the IPAM policies documentation page and the IPAM documentation . For…
articles.summary: Les politiques d'Amazon VPC IPAM prennent désormais en charge le pare-feu internet automatisé d'AWS Network Firewall ainsi que les Lambda Web Functions et MicroVMs. Elles permettent d'attribuer des adresses IPv4 publiques à partir de pools IPAM précis, comme les adresses BYOIP, afin que les équipes de sécurité puissent filtrer par IP en toute confiance. La fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions commerciales d'AWS, dans les niveaux Free Tier et Advanced Tier.
articles.title: Amazon VPC IPAM policies now support automated internet firewall and AWS Lambda Web Functions and MicroVMs

articles.excerpt: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing (formerly AWS Security Agent) now lets you estimate task hours before running a penetration test, so developers and security teams can see how many billable task hours a test is likely to need and choose a maximum task-hours limit with confidence. Continuum for Penetration Testing runs on-demand, AI-driven penetration tests against your web applications and APIs. Previously, the only way to know how long a test would take was to run it, making it difficult to plan budgets and set appropriate usage limits. With task-hour estimates, you open a penetration test, choose the Pentest cost estimate tab, and request an estimate. AWS Continuum runs a short preliminary analysis of your application's scope. It then draws on expertise from past penetration tests to estimate the task hours needed and shows the task hours that most similar applications finish within, and the higher range a few applications require. Requesting an estimate is free, and the estimate is a guide, not a quote or a limit. Actual task hours can be higher or lower, and only the maximum task-hours limit caps usage. Task-hour estimates are available in all AWS Regions where AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing is available. To learn more, see the documentation . To get started, visit the AWS Continuum product page .
articles.summary: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing, anciennement AWS Security Agent, permet désormais d'estimer le nombre d'heures de tâches facturables avant de lancer un test d'intrusion sur applications web et API. L'estimation, gratuite, s'appuie sur une analyse préliminaire du périmètre et sur des tests passés; elle reste indicative et ne plafonne pas l'usage, seule la limite maximale d'heures de tâches le fait. La fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions où le service est disponible.
articles.title: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now estimates task hours before you run a test

Outposts racks extend AWS infrastructure, AWS services, APIs, and tools to virtually any on-premises data center or colocation space for a truly consistent hybrid experience. Organizations of every size, from startups to enterprises to public sector agencies, can now order Outposts racks connected to this newly supported Region to optimize for latency and data residency needs. This regional expansion provides additional flexibility in the number of AWS Regions that customers' Outposts can connect to. To learn more about second-generation Outposts racks, read the AWS Outposts blog post and user guide . articles.summary: AWS prend désormais en charge les racks Outposts de deuxième génération dans la région Asie-Pacifique (Osaka). Les clients peuvent commander ces racks connectés à cette région pour répondre à leurs besoins de latence et de résidence des données. articles.title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now supported in the AWS Asia Pacific (Osaka)

articles.excerpt: AWS Agent Registry now supports registering WebBotAuth (WBA) bots as a new record type, making it easier to verify legitimate bot traffic through a standardized protocol. Previously, organizations lacked a standardized way to distinguish verified bots from malicious traffic. Now, bots can prove domain ownership through WebBotAuth, and you can integrate this verification with AWS WAF Bot Control to write rules that combine verification status and bot identity. This new capability gives content providers and application developers fine-grained control over which bots can access your resources. You can enhance security and improve traffic management by distinguishing legitimate bots from malicious actors. For example, you can allow WBA verified search engine crawlers while blocking unverified traffic or create custom access policies based on both bot identity and verification status. This feature is available in all AWS Regions where AWS Agent Registry is available. To learn more, visit the AWS Agent Registry documentation and the AWS WAF Bot Control documentation .
articles.summary: AWS Agent Registry prend désormais en charge l'enregistrement de bots WebBotAuth (WBA) comme nouveau type d'enregistrement, afin de vérifier plus facilement le trafic de bots légitimes via un protocole standardisé. Les bots peuvent prouver la propriété de leur domaine, et cette vérification peut être intégrée à AWS WAF Bot Control pour écrire des règles combinant statut de vérification et identité du bot. La fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions où AWS Agent Registry est disponible.
articles.title: AWS Agent Registry now supports WebBotAuth bot registration

articles.excerpt: Amazon Transcribe is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region. Customers who need to keep data and operations within the EU for regulatory compliance and data sovereignty requirements can now use automatic speech recognition (ASR) in the Region to turn speech into text. Amazon Transcribe offers two ways to transcribe audio in this Region. Batch transcription processes media files stored in Amazon S3, and streaming transcription returns text in real time from live audio over HTTP/2 or WebSocket. Both support custom vocabularies, so you can improve recognition of domain-specific terms such as product names, industry jargon, and proper nouns. To learn more, see Getting started with Amazon Transcribe , Supported languages and language-specific features , and AWS European Sovereign Cloud pricing .
articles.summary: Amazon Transcribe est désormais disponible dans la région Allemagne de l'AWS European Sovereign Cloud, ce qui permet aux clients qui doivent garder leurs données et opérations dans l'UE de faire de la reconnaissance vocale automatique. Le service offre la transcription par lots de fichiers audio stockés dans Amazon S3 et la transcription en continu en temps réel, avec prise en charge de vocabulaires personnalisés pour les termes propres à un domaine.
articles.title: Amazon Transcribe now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud

articles.excerpt: Amazon Textract Core now lets AI agents extract text, tables, forms, and other data from documents through a skill, with no server to run or infrastructure to deploy. The skill guides an agent to the right Amazon Textract Core API for each document and includes a tested parser that converts the output into reading-order text and structured fields, such as answers to questions, receipt and invoice details, and identity document fields. Previously, teams that connected an agent to Amazon Textract had to build and maintain their own integration. You ask in natural language, and the agent returns the answers you need. The skill processes multi-page PDFs and returns every page in reading order. It uses confidence scores to accept high-confidence results and flags the rest, so you can route them to your own review process. For example, you can ask an agent to turn a patient's intake form into structured data and flag unclear fields for staff review. The skill is available at no additional charge, and standard Amazon Textract pricing applies . It is available in all commercial AWS Regions where Amazon Textract is available, including: US East (Ohio), US East (N. Virginia), US West (N. California), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Canada (Central), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London), Europe (Paris), Europe (Spain), and Europe (Zurich). articles.title: Announcing a new skill for AI agents in Amazon Textract Core

articles.excerpt: AWS Backup now supports incremental backups of Amazon DynamoDB tables, enabling you to reduce backup storage while maintaining backup schedules as frequent as one hour. Until now, AWS Backup created a full copy of your DynamoDB tables. With this launch, after an initial full backup, each incremental backup now captures only the data that changed, and AWS Backup takes a new full backup every 15 days. This lets you store less data and back up more often. You can restore from any recovery point in the chain, and you can schedule incremental backups anywhere from hourly to weekly frequencies. You can store incremental backups in both AWS Backup vaults and logically air-gapped vaults. Cross-Region backup copies are also incremental, further increasing your savings. AWS Backup turns on incremental backups automatically for new customers who protect DynamoDB. If you already back up DynamoDB with AWS Backup, you can turn on incremental backups under advanced features in AWS Backup settings, which lets you manage your backup preferences at the account and region level. You can create and manage incremental backups from the AWS Backup console, the AWS CLI, or the API. Incremental backups for DynamoDB are available in all AWS Regions where AWS Backup protects DynamoDB. To learn more, see working with supported services in the AWS Backup Developer Guide, read the launch blog , and visit the AWS Backup product page . To get started, open the AWS Backup console.
articles.title: AWS Backup now supports incremental backups for Amazon DynamoDB

articles.excerpt: Amazon Route 53 private hosted zones now support public DNS fallback. When a query for a name in your private hosted zone's domain doesn't match a record in the zone, Route 53 returns the answer from public DNS instead of a "name not found" (NXDOMAIN) error. Public DNS fallback is part of the Advanced Hosted Zones offering. Until now, Route 53 treated an associated private hosted zone as fully authoritative for its domain, so queries for names that weren't in the zone returned NXDOMAIN. To resolve a few names privately, customers also had to copy every other record from their public zone into the private hosted zone and keep the two in sync. With public DNS fallback, you add only the names you need privately, and every other name resolves from your existing public DNS. For example, your private hosted zone for example.com points example.com to a private endpoint, while partner.example.com exists only in public DNS. Before, a lookup for partner.example.com returned NXDOMAIN. Now it resolves from public DNS. To get started, create a private Advanced Hosted Zone or upgrade an existing private hosted zone, and then turn on public DNS fallback. You can use the Route 53 console, API, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, or AWS CloudFormation. Public DNS fallback is available in all AWS commercial Regions where Route 53 private hosted zones are available. To learn more, see Enabling public DNS fallback for a private hosted zone in the Route 53 Developer Guide and the Route 53 pricing page .
articles.title: Amazon Route 53 private hosted zones now support public DNS fallback

articles.excerpt: Amazon VPC Lattice now publishes Amazon CloudWatch metrics for VPC resources. Resource owners — those who share resources via VPC Lattice — and resource consumers — those who access those shared resources — can now see TCP traffic to resources such as databases, clusters, and on-premises endpoints. Resource owners get metrics for resource gateways and resource configurations. Consumers get metrics for resource endpoints, service network endpoints, and service network VPC associations. Previously, resource access logs were the primary way to see this traffic, but they required additional processing and provided limited real-time visibility. Now you can monitor your layer-4 resources directly in CloudWatch. With these metrics, you can proactively catch connectivity issues and optimize resource capacity. Capacity planning metrics — including bytes processed, new flows, and active flows — let resource owners monitor traffic per resource gateway and per resource configuration to track load on shared resources. Reliability metrics, such as dropped packets, help you detect problems early. Resource gateways also report port allocation errors, which show when a resource gateway needs more IPv4 addresses per network interface. Consumers can monitor traffic per resource endpoint, service network endpoint, or service network VPC association. They can set CloudWatch alarms for when new flows drop to zero or dropped packets increase, catching an unreachable resource before their…
articles.title: Amazon VPC Lattice now supports CloudWatch metrics for VPC resources

articles.excerpt: AWS DevOps Agent now gives you ways to share and leverage skills, MCP servers, connectors, and custom agents that enhance the capabilities of your AWS DevOps Agent instances. The AWS DevOps Agent Tools open source repository is a centralized, AWS-curated collection of tools that extend AWS DevOps Agent capabilities. Customers can import ready-to-use, quality-controlled tools directly into their DevOps Agent configurations to improve investigation quality and expand operational context. A growing community of AWS DevOps Agent users and partners, and AWS service and support teams, have contributed a growing collection of tools to the community, including several partner-managed connectors that simplify connecting AWS DevOps Agent to third party MCP servers. Partners providing connectors include: Bluebox, Bronto, Celonis, Clickhouse Observability, Coralogix, Cribl, Elastic, Halo, Honeycomb, LaunchDarkly, Neo4j, Sumo Logic, and Wiz. To get started, browse the skills and connector catalogs from within your AWS DevOps Agent instance, or add and share your own tools by creating a PR within the AWS DevOps Agent Tools repository. See all the latest AWS DevOps Agent features on the release history page. For the list of AWS Regions where AWS DevOps Agent is available, see the supported Regions table .
articles.title: AWS DevOps Agent adds community and partner tools repository

articles.excerpt: AWS DevOps Agent now extends its chat capabilities across MCP clients like Kiro and Claude Code, as well as Slack and Microsoft Teams channels. With Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, AWS DevOps Agent can now take directed chat actions including support for GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, and PagerDuty MCP tools, giving developers and operations teams powerful workflow automation directly from their preferred chat interface. This launch also adds auto-creation of per-incident Slack code channels and bi-directional chat within Microsoft Teams. AWS DevOps Agent has access to a compute sandbox that it can use to execute scripts and access the network to work more efficiently, and users can now rename and archive chats across all supported platforms. See all the latest AWS DevOps Agent features on the release history page. For the list of AWS Regions where AWS DevOps Agent is available, see the supported Regions table .
articles.title: AWS DevOps Agent adds new chat capabilities

articles.excerpt: Amazon Textract Insights brings document understanding to Amazon Textract. It is a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract, and is now generally available in the US East (N. Virginia) and US West (Oregon) AWS Regions. Amazon Textract Insights splits, classifies, and extracts structured data from documents in a single asynchronous request. Documents like insurance claims, tax packets, and onboarding packages often arrive as one long scan that holds many documents in no fixed order. Processing them has meant assembling and operating separate steps for text detection, splitting, classification, and extraction. Amazon Textract Insights handles that work in one managed request, with no AI models to train. How it works: You define the fields you need in a blueprint, a JSON schema that describes each field in natural language, or you can start from a library of AWS public blueprints for common document types such as W-2s, invoices, and bank statements. Amazon Textract Insights can split each file into separate sub-documents, classify each one by matching it to the best-fitting blueprint, and extract your fields. It returns a confidence score for every value and grounds each one to its location on the page, so you can automate high-confidence results and route the rest to human review. It can also return Markdown, HTML, and plain text for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications, generate document summaries and figure captions, and detect and redact personally…
articles.title: Amazon Textract Insights is now generally available

articles.excerpt: When an incident is occurring, mean time to recover needs to be as fast as possible. With this launch, incident investigations performed by AWS DevOps Agent complete faster. Investigations now also include a real-time summary that is updated with the current state of an investigation, so initial findings and observations surface quickly, before a final root cause and mitigation plan are created. For customers using AWS DevOps Agent's built in Slack integration, these summaries are also automatically pushed to the relevant Slack channel. See all the latest AWS DevOps Agent features on the release history page. For the list of AWS Regions where AWS DevOps Agent is available, see the supported Regions table .
articles.title: AWS DevOps Agent reduces investigation latency

articles.excerpt: AWS Lambda MicroVMs now supports customer managed keys (CMK) in AWS Key Management Service (KMS) for data encryption at rest. CMK gives you full control over the lifecycle and usage of your KMS keys , helping meet compliance requirements in regulated industries like financial services and healthcare. Lambda MicroVMs is a serverless compute primitive that provides VM-level isolation, near-instant launch and resume, and state preservation for executing user or AI generated code. Use MicroVMs to build applications like AI coding assistants, interactive development environments, and vulnerability scanners. To get started, create a CMK in AWS KMS and configure its cryptographic properties, metadata, and AWS IAM access permissions. Then, specify this CMK as a parameter when you create a MicroVM image or run a MicroVM. Lambda uses this CMK to encrypt your MicroVM image, MicroVM image environment variables, and the payload passed to the MicroVM run hook. You can use CMK with Lambda MicroVMs through the AWS Lambda console , AWS CloudFormation , AWS Cloud Development Kit , or with your preferred Agentic development tools using the Agent Toolkit for AWS . ​​CMK support for MicroVMs is available in the following AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Ireland), Europe (Spain), Europe (Stockholm)…
articles.title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs now supports customer managed keys in AWS KMS

articles.excerpt: The AWS Secrets Store CSI Driver Provider now supports AssumeRole (role-chaining), allowing Kubernetes pods to access secrets and parameters across AWS accounts by assuming an IAM role in the account where the secrets are stored. Previously, customers reading cross-account secrets needed to add a resource policy to each secret and use a customer-managed KMS key, as the AWS managed key (aws/secretsmanager) cannot be used for cross-account access. Now, teams can name a target role in the SecretProviderClass, and the provider assumes that role to fetch the secrets. With AssumeRole support, customers managing hundreds of AWS accounts and thousands of services can simplify cross-account secret access. A single trust policy on one target role replaces resource policies on each secret. Secrets encrypted with the AWS managed key (aws/secretsmanager) and SSM parameters become readable across accounts. The target account sees workload-specific session names in CloudTrail events for better attribution. This feature works with both IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) and EKS Pod Identity on initial mount and rotation, and supports failover regions. AssumeRole support is available in all AWS Regions where Amazon EKS and the AWS Secrets Store CSI Driver Provider are available. To learn more, see the Assume an IAM role to retrieve secrets with the ASCP documentation.
articles.title: AWS Secrets Store CSI Driver Provider now supports AssumeRole for cross-account secret access

articles.excerpt: AWS Agent Registry now offers public naming capabilities, making it easy to attach verified domain names to your agents and AI tools. Developers and network admins can perform domain verification checks to prove domain ownership, then associate the verified domain names with their agents to promote them for public visibility beyond their registry and AWS account. Previously, developers had to manually configure how agents discover and connect to one another, which added complexity to building multi-agent systems. With this launch, since the public agent records are anchored to a verified domain identity, you can confirm the source of an agent before connecting to it. Once published, agent records are searchable by any AWS-authenticated user using both semantic and lexical search. This capability is available at no additional charge at this time in all AWS Regions where AWS Agent Registry is available. To learn more about naming and public discovery, visit the AWS Agent Registry documentation .
articles.title: AWS Agent Registry now offers naming and public discovery capabilities

articles.excerpt: Amazon Route 53 now offers Advanced Hosted Zones, a new hosted zone tier with additional guardrails, visibility, and resilience features. Advanced Hosted Zones include Change Guardrails that prevent accidental record deletions, record-level Change History, and public DNS fallback in private hosted zones. A single mistaken DNS change can take part of your domain offline, such as deleting a record that is still serving traffic or removing a delegation that resolvers are still using. To protect against this, customers build their own validation pipelines, review processes, and audit tooling. With Change Guardrails turned on, Route 53 checks each change before applying it. It blocks deleting a record that is still receiving DNS queries, a record that an alias record in the same hosted zone points to, or a delegation that is still in use. When a guardrail blocks a change, Route 53 rejects the whole request with an error that explains why, and no records change. Guardrails apply to every change, including changes from infrastructure as code tools. Change History gives you a record-level history of changes to your hosted zone, retained for 365 days, so you can see what changed and when. To get started, create a new Advanced Hosted Zone or upgrade an existing hosted zone, then turn on the guardrails you want. You can use the Route 53 console, API, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, or AWS CloudFormation. Advanced Hosted Zones are priced separately from Standard Hosted Zones. For rates, see the…
articles.title: Amazon Route 53 now offers Advanced Hosted Zones

articles.excerpt: AWS Device Farm , a service for testing mobile and web apps, now provides Test Insights for Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest runs across multiple devices. Test Insights helps you and AI agents understand the health of your tests and resolve failures faster by providing a detailed breakdown of your test suite by device and by test. With Test Insights, Device Farm's existing APIs now return enhanced test metadata, failure root cause with stack trace, a video for each test, start and stop times, median and average times spent on each device and test, and test counts by result. With this data in one place, your agents spend less time and fewer tokens looking for the root cause of test failures, and the AWS Device Farm troubleshooting skill uses it to help diagnose failed runs and suggest fixes. Test Insights is available alongside any default and custom test reports you generate, at no additional cost. Test Insights is included in all AWS Regions where Device Farm is available. To get started, see Test Insights in the AWS Device Farm Developer Guide.
articles.title: Announcing Test Insights for AWS Device Farm

articles.excerpt: Improved blueprints: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now gives project teams more ownership of their data and resources, within governance policies that administrators set centrally. Additional releases include faster notebook queries through DuckDB 2.0 support and data quality monitoring at catalog scale. Improved data quality monitoring: Teams can also profile entire catalogs and databases to keep data statistics current. articles.summary: La COP31 reste dans l'impasse samedi, après une nuit de négociations infructueuse entre les quelque 200 pays réunis pour tenter de conclure un accord consensuel. La société civile qualifie la conférence de « pire COP de tous les temps ».
articles.title: La Presse en Turquie | « La pire COP de tous les temps »

articles.excerpt: Est-ce que l’intelligence artificielle (IA) va révolutionner les soins dentaires ? Si on se fie à une expérience menée par La Presse, elle risque du moins de changer radicalement les diagnostics reçus par certains patients, en augmentant de façon marquée le nombre de problèmes décelés dans leur bouche. Pour le meilleur ? Ou pour le pire ? Un dossier de Gabrielle Duchaine d’Ariane Lacoursière
articles.group_summary: La Presse s'intéresse aux pratiques des dentistes. Une enquête montre que les plans de traitement varient beaucoup d'un dentiste à l'autre. Une expérience suggère que l'IA pourrait faire détecter beaucoup plus de problèmes, ce qui soulève des questions de confiance.
articles.group_title: Dossier de La Presse sur la dentisterie et l'IA
articles.summary: Une expérience menée par La Presse suggère que l'intelligence artificielle pourrait transformer les diagnostics dentaires, en augmentant nettement le nombre de problèmes détectés chez certains patients. Le dossier, signé Gabrielle Duchaine et Ariane Lacoursière, pose la question des bénéfices et des risques de cette pratique.
articles.title: L’IA chez le dentiste, pour le meilleur ou pour le pire

articles.excerpt: Des plans de traitement considérablement différents pour la même bouche. Des actes courants, comme le nettoyage tous les six mois, davantage guidés par la tradition – ou le modèle d’affaires – que par la médecine. Notre enquête lève le voile sur une réalité méconnue : la dentisterie « n’est pas une science exacte » et les pratiques sont loin d’être uniformes.
articles.summary: Une enquête de La Presse montre que les plans de traitement dentaire varient considérablement d'un dentiste à l'autre pour une même condition buccale. Des actes courants, comme le nettoyage tous les six mois, seraient davantage guidés par la tradition ou le modèle d'affaires que par la médecine. Le reportage conclut que la dentisterie n'est pas une science exacte et que les pratiques sont loin d'être uniformes.
articles.title: La loterie du fauteuil de dentiste

articles.excerpt: La lutte contre les changements climatiques peut aussi se faire en dehors du cadre des Nations unies, comme en témoignent les nombreux États adoptant une feuille de route pour se sevrer des énergies fossiles, dont le Québec. Le Canada, lui, n’est pas du nombre.
articles.summary: Le Québec prévoit publier une feuille de route pour réduire sa dépendance aux énergies fossiles, dans la foulée de la COP31. Plusieurs États adoptent de telles feuilles de route en dehors du cadre des Nations unies, alors que le Canada n'en fait pas partie.
articles.title: COP31 | Le Québec entend publier une feuille de route pour se sevrer des énergies fossiles

articles.excerpt: C’est déjà difficile de savoir à qui se fier, imaginez quand l’IA s’en mêle avec ses propres idées sur la question.
articles.summary: Un article de La Presse aborde l'arrivée de l'intelligence artificielle dans les cabinets de dentistes, en la comparant à une question de confiance envers les fournisseurs, comme pour une thermopompe. L'extrait est court et suggère surtout que la difficulté de savoir à qui se fier se complique avec l'IA.
articles.title: Arrivée de l’IA dans les cabinets de dentistes | Ses dents, ma thermopompe, même dilemme

articles.excerpt: Phillip A. Washington a un charisme hors du commun. Tellement qu’il a réussi à mettre Jésus de son bord !
articles.summary: Un article de La Presse présente la solution imaginée par Phillip A. Washington à ce qui est décrit comme un « trou » de 65 milliards dans les infrastructures. L'extrait, très court, ne précise ni la nature exacte de cette solution ni le contexte du financement.
articles.title: Infrastructures | Une solution « made in L.A. » à notre « trou » de 65 milliards

articles.excerpt: « N’ayons pas l’air incompétents… » Peu après l’arrivée au pouvoir de François Legault en 2018, son chef de cabinet donnait en privé ce modeste objectif. Car il devinait l’ampleur de la tâche. Rien ne prépare tout à fait à devenir premier ministre et à diriger le Québec.
articles.summary: Un article de La Presse s'intéresse au Parti québécois et aux difficultés de l'opposition. Il rapporte qu'après l'arrivée au pouvoir de François Legault en 2018, son chef de cabinet visait en privé simplement à ne pas paraître incompétent, signe de l'ampleur de la tâche de gouverner le Québec.
articles.title: Parti québécois | Le trouble de l’opposition

articles.excerpt: La perspective d’une montée de l’extrême droite et d’une victoire de Marine Le Pen n’est pas le seul écueil à l’horizon.
articles.summary: Le rapprochement entre le Canada et l'Union européenne pourrait être compromis par l'élection présidentielle française. L'extrait évoque la possibilité d'une montée de l'extrême droite et d'une victoire de Marine Le Pen, présentée comme un écueil parmi d'autres.
articles.title: Le rapprochement Canada-UE menacé par la présidentielle française

articles.summary: Selon le titre et l'extrait, l'arrestation de Nicolás Maduro a ravivé les aspirations démocratiques au Venezuela, où la population attend désormais la tenue d'élections. L'extrait est court et ne précise ni les circonstances de l'arrestation ni le calendrier électoral.

articles.title: Les partys de bureau du temps des Fêtes s’adaptent à l’époque

articles.title: Les «considérations idéologiques» et l’éducation supérieure

Selon l'extrait, rien ne démontre qu'une telle réduction soit la voie à privilégier. Le reste de l'argumentaire ne figure pas dans l'extrait fourni.

articles.summary: Céline Donahoe, retraitée de 69 ans, lutte pour garder son logement, qu'elle n'a plus les moyens de payer. Elle affirme refuser de devenir itinérante. Le récit illustre la précarité résidentielle des aînés à faible revenu.
articles.title: «Je refuse de devenir itinérante», le cri du cœur de Céline Donahoe

articles.summary: Une chronique du Devoir soutient que contraindre une fillette d'ici à cacher ses cheveux en public et à l'école constitue une injustice intolérable. articles.summary: Le NPD accuse les libéraux d'adopter une approche coloniale dans leur projet de loi sur les grands projets. Le parti réclame des protections plus solides pour les droits des Autochtones dans ce texte.
articles.title: NDP makes plea for stronger Indigenous rights protections in major projects bill

articles.excerpt: BarBurrito issued an apology to its customers after pea-sized stones were found in some of its burritos at restaurants in Alberta. The company says the rocks came from a particular brand of beans that it is no longer using.
articles.summary: La chaîne de restaurants BarBurrito s'est excusée auprès de ses clients après que des cailloux de la taille d'un pois ont été trouvés dans certains burritos servis en Alberta. Selon l'entreprise, les cailloux provenaient d'une marque de haricots qu'elle n'utilise plus.
articles.title: 'We are sorry': Rocks found in restaurant burritos in Alberta

articles.excerpt: Anger and frustration with Peguis Child and Family Services came to a head Thursday when the First Nation's chief and band members tried to enter the organization's building, and a chain was attached to its doors in an apparent attempt to break them open.
articles.summary: Des membres de la Première Nation de Peguis, dont le chef et un conseiller, ont tenté d'expulser le dirigeant des Services à l'enfance et à la famille de Peguis. Jeudi, la colère et la frustration envers cet organisme ont culminé lorsque le chef et des membres de la bande ont tenté d'entrer dans l'édifice, une chaîne ayant été fixée aux portes pour apparemment les forcer.
articles.title: Peguis First Nation members, including chief and councillor, try to oust CFS leader

articles.excerpt: Historically, the average high on Nov. 19 has been around 7.5 C in Toronto, so the weather outside is noticeably warmer. That's welcome news to those who fear the cold, but should we be concerned?
articles.summary: Un article de CBC annonce un hiver plus doux que la normale dans le sud de l'Ontario. L'extrait mentionne que la température maximale moyenne du 19 novembre à Toronto est d'environ 7,5 °C, et que les températures actuelles sont nettement plus élevées.
articles.title: Mild months ahead: What we know about this winter across southern Ontario

articles.excerpt: An unprecedented federal hearing for an independent power producer's application to export all its electricity from a small B.C. community to the U.S. for 30 years wrapped up on Friday, after arguments from the company and local intervenors opposed to the deal.
articles.summary: Une audience fédérale sans précédent s'est terminée vendredi sur la demande d'un producteur indépendant d'électricité visant à exporter toute sa production d'une petite collectivité de la Colombie-Britannique vers les États-Unis pendant 30 ans. Des intervenants locaux s'opposent à ce projet, et leurs arguments ont été entendus avec ceux de l'entreprise.
articles.title: Hearing on controversial plans to export power from Powell River to U.S. wraps up

articles.excerpt: Café 5thFloor in the city’s LaSalle borough doesn’t take tips. Instead it pays its workers a livable wage. If customers are compelled to tip, the coffee shop takes donations that go to the non-profit, Centraide.
articles.summary: Le café Café 5thFloor, situé dans l'arrondissement LaSalle à Montréal, n'accepte pas de pourboires et verse plutôt à ses employés un salaire viable. Si des clients se sentent obligés de laisser un pourboire, le café recueille ces dons au profit de l'organisme sans but lucratif Centraide.
articles.title: Tips are off the table at this Montreal café — and customers are into it

articles.excerpt: Ontario Liberals will choose their new leader today as the once dominant party makes its latest attempt to escape the political wilderness and insiders say no "runaway winner" has emerged over the course of the lenghty race.
articles.summary: Le Parti libéral de l'Ontario doit choisir aujourd'hui son nouveau chef, au terme d'une longue course à la direction. Selon des initiés, aucun favori clair n'a émergé au fil de la campagne. Le parti, jadis dominant, cherche à sortir de la traversée du désert politique.
articles.title: Ontario Liberals to elect new leader today after lengthy race

articles.excerpt: Swiss prosecutors have opened criminal proceedings against former NHL forward Daniel Carr on suspicion of attempted serious assault over an on-ice incident in a Swiss National League game last month.
articles.summary: Le ministère public suisse a ouvert une procédure pénale contre Daniel Carr, ancien attaquant de la LNH, pour soupçon de tentative de voies de fait graves. L'affaire fait suite à un incident survenu sur la glace lors d'un match de la Ligue nationale suisse le mois dernier.
articles.title: Canadian hockey player Daniel Carr faces Swiss criminal probe over on-ice punch

articles.excerpt: William (Billy) Hall was just 16 when he moved from North Sydney, N.S., to Ontario in late 1966 seeking better economic opportunities, as many of his siblings had before him. Within less than a year, he was murdered. A retired Ontario lawyer is now trying to find the lead that breaks the case.
articles.summary: Un avocat ontarien à la retraite reprend l'enquête sur le meurtre de Billy Hall, un adolescent de 16 ans originaire de North Sydney, en Nouvelle-Écosse, qui avait déménagé en Ontario fin 1966 pour chercher de meilleures perspectives économiques. Il a été assassiné moins d'un an plus tard, en 1967, et l'affaire demeure non résolue.
articles.title: Who killed Billy Hall? Retired lawyer probes 1967 murder of Cape Breton teen

articles.excerpt: A Calgary man who threatened to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney and one of his children in videos posted to social media pleaded guilty to a number of offences on Friday.
articles.summary: Un homme de Calgary a plaidé coupable à plusieurs infractions après avoir menacé de tuer le premier ministre Mark Carney et l'un de ses enfants dans des vidéos publiées sur les réseaux sociaux. Le plaidoyer a été entendu un vendredi.
articles.title: Calgary man who threatened to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney in TikTok, YouTube videos pleads guilty

articles.excerpt: Davis Schneider became a free agent Friday after the Toronto Blue Jays declined to offer him a contract for 2027.
articles.summary: Davis Schneider devient agent libre après quatre saisons avec les Blue Jays de Toronto. L'équipe a choisi de ne pas lui offrir de contrat pour la saison 2027.
articles.title: Davis Schneider becomes free agent after 4 seasons with Blue Jays

articles.excerpt: Federal Justice Minister Sean Fraser is encouraging more lawyers to apply to be judges, and warns the profession can't be undermined by political actors who attack the credibility of the courts.
articles.summary: Le ministre fédéral de la Justice, Sean Fraser, encourage davantage d'avocats à poser leur candidature à la magistrature. Il met en garde contre des acteurs politiques qui attaquent la crédibilité des tribunaux, qu'il décrit comme un « récit inquiétant » gagnant du terrain dans les critiques des décisions des juges.
articles.title: Justice minister warns 'troubling narrative' creeping into criticism of judges' decisions

articles.excerpt: It will be the 10th Tournament of Hearts held in B.C. and the first since Kerri Einarson won her fourth straight Canadian title in Kamloops in 2023.
articles.summary: Vernon, en Colombie-Britannique, accueillera le tournoi Scotties Tournament of Hearts de curling en 2028. Ce sera le 10e tournoi de ce type tenu en Colombie-Britannique et le premier depuis 2023, année où Kerri Einarson a remporté son quatrième titre canadien consécutif à Kamloops.
articles.title: Vernon to host curling's Scotties Tournament of Hearts in 2028

articles.excerpt: A Windsor, Ont., police officer has pleaded guilty to uttering threats and was given a conditional discharge for a second time, related to two separate cases.
articles.summary: Un policier de Windsor, en Ontario, a plaidé coupable à des accusations de menaces et a reçu une absolution conditionnelle pour la deuxième fois, dans deux affaires distinctes. L'extrait ne précise pas davantage les faits ni les détails des dossiers.
articles.title: 'I should know better': Windsor police officer gets 2nd conditional discharge after latest guilty plea

articles.excerpt: A new study commissioned by the group behind Eastern Canada's proposed high-speed rail line lays out the project's potential to benefit people's lives, their communities and the region's economy if it's done right.
articles.summary: Une étude commandée par le promoteur de la future ligne ferroviaire à grande vitesse proposée dans l'Est du Canada, Alto, présente les bénéfices potentiels du projet pour la vie des gens, les collectivités et l'économie régionale, à condition qu'il soit bien réalisé. L'extrait ne fournit pas de chiffres précis sur les gains annoncés.
articles.title: Alto-backed study predicts major economic gains along proposed high-speed rail corridor
